clinician.summary: Female patient diagnosis: Haemorrhoids [K64.9]. Flexible sigmoidoscopy showed inflamed mucosa in the sigmoid and descending colon, biopsies taken. Excision of skin tags. Phenol injection in haemorrhoids at 12 Oc. Post-op instructions: never deny the call to stool, 5 portions of fresh fruit/vegetables daily, 3 litres of water, do not strain, avoid constipation, do not spend more than 3 minutes on toilet. Telephone appointment with patient 6 weeks

patient.summary: female patient was admitted for a scheduled procedure to treat haemorrhoids (enlarged veins in the rectum and anus). During the procedure, the doctor examined the patient's rectum and removed some skin tags. The doctor also injected the haemorrhoids to help reduce the swelling. The patient was given instructions to avoid constipation and straining during bowel movements. The patient has a follow-up appointment scheduled with the doctor in 6 weeks to check on the progress

pharmacist.summary: No medications were documented in this discharge summary. The patient was treated for haemorrhoids and did not have any new prescriptions. The post-operative instructions advised the patient to avoid constipation, not to strain, and to drink 3 litres of water per day. No drug monitoring or potential interactions were mentioned.
